announcements.headline: Result of GM
announcements.insight: The result of the GM follows the June AGM and October prospectus publication. Shareholders should monitor subsequent fundraising steps outlined in the July intention.

announcements.headline: Publication of Prospectus and Circular
announcements.insight: Following the July intention to fundraise, PGV publishes its prospectus and circular. This marks a key step in the capital raising process initiated earlier this year.

announcements.headline: Half-year Report
announcements.insight: PGV issues a half-year report following its May annual results. This follows the June AGM and July fundraise intention.

announcements.headline: Intention to Fundraise
announcements.insight: The intention to fundraise follows the May offer close. Shareholders should watch for further details on this capital raising step.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results follow the May notice and June offer closure. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for any further corporate actions.

announcements.headline: Close of Offer to Further Applications
announcements.insight: The offer has closed following the May annual report. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent steps regarding these further applications.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report & Notice of AGM
announcements.insight: Praetura Growth Vct publishes its Annual Financial Report and notices an AGM. Shareholders should review the financial results and vote at the upcoming meeting.
